title: harness delivery tests fail: is_valid_mailbox_host rejects 127.0.0.1
description: The IP-range enforcement in is_valid_mailbox_host (added in KITH-gpz5) rejects loopback addresses, breaking the integration test harness that uses 127.0.0.1:port for bob's listener. outbox_tick calls record_failure instead of delivering, so the outbox row is never deleted. Affects: harness::full_message_delivery, harness::offline_delivery_and_retry, harness::full_message_delivery_with_attachment, inner::read_receipt_round_trip, inner::group_chat_delivers_to_reachable_peer. Fix: add #[cfg(feature = "test-utils")] bypass for is_loopback() in is_valid_mailbox_host, since loopback is never reachable in production but is needed in test harness.
